messages:
ana-peopleops: FYI new hire Emily filed a name change after marriage and her SSN card is delayed. She starts next week and asked about benefits & payroll. Any immediate steps?

matt-payroll: If SSN is delayed we can still add her to payroll but need a signed SSA-89 or SSN application receipt for payroll tax forms. Payroll also needs the exact name that will be on tax docs. @emily-newhire can you confirm which name is on your passport and which is changing?

emily-newhire: Passport still shows my maiden name. I submitted SSN update and requested a new card; SSA gave me a receipt (M10 token). Also I mailed a certified marriage certificate; will that work for benefits?

raj-immigration: For I-9 we must match identity docs to the name on the I-9. If passport is maiden name and EAD/authorization is under same, use those for Section 2. If SSN arrives later with new name, we can update payroll records. For immigration filings, keep copies of marriage cert + translations if foreign.

sara-benefits: Benefits enrollment needs subscriber legal name and SSN when available. We can provisionally enroll Emily under the maiden name and update SSN later. For dependent coverage (spouse), we need marriage certificate plus spouse ID. If the marriage certificate is certified and in English, upload to the HR portal. Deadline for initial enrollment paperwork is 30 days from start.

emily-newhire: Great. Is a photo of the SSA receipt OK to upload, or do you need the original in person?

ana-peopleops: Upload the SSA receipt (screen grab) + marriage cert scan to the secure HR portal. Originals can be shown at new hire orientation or during the I-9 in-person check. We'll add a note linking Emily's payroll file and benefits enrollment for follow-up once SSN card arrives.

matt-payroll: One small payroll wrinkle: if the SSN changes name we need a copy of the social card to update W-2 name mapping before year-end. Please notify payroll when card arrives so we can reissue if needed.

raj-immigration: For EAD holders: if the EAD shows the old name and the SSN shows the new one, maintain internal mapping and keep copies of both documents. Don't swap I-9 docs unless originals presented.

hr-bot: Reminder set: "Check Emily SSN card upload" in 14 days.

sara-benefits: I'll tentatively enroll and set up outreach for dependents if Emily wants that. Emily, DM me if you want benefits walkthrough before start.

emily-newhire: Thanks everyone, uploading docs now. Appreciate the guidance.

ana-peopleops: Excellent 2D thank you. We'll track this in the onboarding checklist and close the loop when SSN card is uploaded. :white_check_mark:
